class.name: SteamVideo
class.brief_description: Reads Steam video descriptors and local broadcast state.
class.description: Use [method SteamClient.video] after boot. Entitlement and a processed Steam Video AppID are required for playback. Identical lookups coalesce across client scopes. A pending observation times out after 15 seconds. Steam can still finish the native lookup after that.

method.name: broadcast_status
method.description: Reads whether Steam is uploading a broadcast and how many viewers are watching.

method.name: projection_settings
method.description: Await a [SteamStringResult] with the 360-degree projection settings for the specified video AppID. Concurrent lookups of the same AppID share a single Steam request.

method.name: stream_url
method.description: Await a [SteamStringResult] with the Steam-issued stream URL for an entitled video AppID. Treat this URL as temporary and keep it out of logs.

signal.name: broadcast_started
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reports a local broadcast upload started.

signal.name: broadcast_stopped
signal.description: Emitted with the SDK broadcast upload result code when the local upload stops.
